verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is an API-first transcription service, so it runs headlessly by design. Jobs are created programmatically by URL or file upload and polled through a status endpoint. It also offers completion webhooks, SSE progress streaming, auth and health check endpoints suited to automated pipelines, and a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g. a GitHub Actions example), and independent hands-on corroboration of use in CI pipelines.
